description.value:
Frequency once per day

A mixture of resin and corrosive slime oozes from you and trails behind you as you move. You Climb or Stride twice. You leave a trail of slime in each square you leave as part of this movement, and each square adjacent to those squares, except the square where you end your movement. Each square containing slime becomes difficult terrain as well as hazardous terrain, dealing @Damage[2[acid]] damage for each square a creature moves through. The slime dries out, ending these effects, after 1 minute.

At 17th level, the hazardous terrain deals @Damage[6[acid]] damage.
